title: Balance Rate Cut on Pocketwire Personal Account Instant Cash-Outs
content:
The balance rate cut of the instant fee rate on a Pocketwire Personal Account reads the ledger balance before the transfer and the account's age: for an account at least 90 days old holding USD 5000.00 or more the cut is 0.20 percentage points; for an account at least 90 days old holding USD 2500.00 or more but less than 5000.00 it is 0.10 percentage points; otherwise it is 0.

**Which balance is read?** The account's ledger balance on the handling date before the instant cash-out and its fee are taken off it.

**How is the account's age measured?** As the number of calendar days from the opened date to the handling date; both bands need at least 90 days.

**What are the bands?**

| Account age | Ledger balance before the transfer | Rate cut |
|---|---|---|
| 90 days or more | 5000.00 or more | 0.20 percentage points |
| 90 days or more | 2500.00 up to 4999.99 | 0.10 percentage points |
| 90 days or more | Below 2500.00 | 0 |
| Up to 89 days | Any | 0 |

**Some edges (hypothetical):** an account 120 days old holding 5000.00 gets 0.20, holding 4999.99 gets 0.10; an account 89 days old holding 9000.00 gets 0.
